description: Defines the abstract class 'CodeModule' which encapsulates information about loaded code modules, including addresses, file paths, identifiers, and version info, used in crash processing or debugging.

classes.name: CodeModule
classes.description: Abstract class representing a code module loaded into a process, providing methods to access its address, size, file paths, identifiers, version, and cloning capability.

methods.name: ~CodeModule
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the CodeModule class.

methods.name: base_address
methods.description: Returns the base address of the code module as loaded in the process.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the code module.

methods.name: code_file
methods.description: Returns the file path or name from which the code module was loaded.

methods.name: code_identifier
methods.description: Returns an identifier string for the code module, such as UUID or version.

methods.name: debug_file
methods.description: Returns the filename containing debugging info for the code module.

methods.name: debug_identifier
methods.description: Returns an identifier for the debug file, similar to code_identifier.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns a human-readable version string of the code module.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new copy of the CodeModule object.
